title: Relative Langlands duality of the Bump-Friedberg-Ginzburg $\mathrm{GSO}_6$-integral
summary: We provide a new instance of singular relative Langlands duality, underlying a Rankin-Selberg integral on $\mathrm{GSO}_6$ due to Bump-Friedberg-Ginzburg. We conclude that this integral represents an essentially self-dual object in the relative Langlands program, and we demonstrate that the Langlands dual automorphic integral computes a finite sum of $L$-functions, reflecting stacky structure on the spectral side.
